Dana (CS): Dropping a short 'soft-landing' play for renewal-risk customers that are migrating traffic. Focus: seed, shape, observe, capture feedback. Keep this to 5 actions + probe commands.
Clara (Customer): This looks useful. Can your team provide exact commands and a tiny config we can paste into our deploy? We want to avoid burst errors during our migration window.
Dana (CS): Yes. Below is the handoff we give field teams. It's intentionally compact so it can be copy/pasted into a runbook.
--- soft-landing play (3 phases) ---
Phase A (Prep, -30m): seed + baseline
- Run 4 distinct seed requests to top endpoints to warm KV + caches. Example seed command (run from CI):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Seeded warmup: welcome","max_tokens":24,"mode":"seed"}'
```
- Baseline capture: take a single health probe
```
GET /v0/health/soft-landing -> {"status":"ok","prefill_hits":N}
```
Phase B (Cutover, 0-60m): shape traffic + safe defaults
- Apply the minimal safe config: enable prefill on primary routes, tiny batch window, and a short seed TTL. Pasteable snippet: 
```json
{ "prefill": true, "prefill_ttl_sec": 300, "max_prefill_concurrency": 3, "batch_window_ms": 30, "circuit_breaker_error_pct": 7 }
```
- Soft ramp policy: start at 10% traffic for 10m -> 30% for 15m -> surge-check, then 60% -> full. If error_rate >= 6% at any step, pause ramp and run rollback.
Phase C (Stabilize, 1-72h): collect signals + feedback
- Keep seed TTL=5m for 24h, capture one failed-generation exemplar and one slow trace per 8h. Tag with `cs:soft-landing:<acct>` and `cs:renewal-risk`.
- If streaming latency spikes (>800ms p95), temporarily increase batch_window_ms to 100 and route to smaller quantized variant for 2 min, then re-evaluate.
--- operational checklist (copyable) ---
1) Seed 4 prompts 30m pre-cutover.
2) Apply safe config snippet before traffic shift.
3) Execute soft ramp schedule; monitor error_rate and p95 latency.
4) If error_rate > 6% or circuit tripped: disable prefill, increase batch_window_ms, switch to fallback model, open incident `cs-soft-landing-<acct>`.
5) Upload 3 failure exemplars + 2 slow traces to the shared GH issue over first 24h.
Noel (Eng): Add `prefill_key` naming convention so we can filter traces: `prefill_key:cs_soft_<acct>`. Also recommend `max_seed_concurrency:4` to protect control plane.
Victor (SRE): For safety, include this lightweight health probe (off by default):
```
GET /v0/health/prefill_status -> {"prefill_status":"ok","last_seed_iso":"2026-03-22T12:34:56Z","cache_hits":N}
```
Marta (CSE): For customer enablement calls, we ask them to run the seed commands live and to attach these outputs to the ticket. Also provide a 10-prompt sample pack (6 happy, 2 edge, 2 adversarial) and ask them to flag outputs that look low-quality.
Clara (Customer): We'll run seeds and report back. Can you also include a template message our ops team can use if they hit errors?
Dana (CS): Yes, quick incident template below for the team to paste into the ticket when fallback is triggered:
"Account <acct>: soft-landing fallback triggered at <ts>. Actions taken: disabled prefill, switched to smaller model `<model>`, increased batch_window_ms to 100, seeded KV. Attached: slow-trace.zip, failures.json. Please triage with SRE."
Ops Bot: Reminder: ensure traces are tagged with `cs:soft-landing` and create a ticket labeled `priority:renewal-risk` if fallback is used.
Dana (CS): I'll add this 1-pager to the onboarding kit and link the prompt pack. Keeping thread short 1: will follow up if we standardize this into a template library. Thanks team :thumbsup:
